schema: LAISE TUK2 Automated Mastering Selection v1.0

targets.rationale: Target derived from Tukana II measured crest factor and LRA; not copied from another song.

processing.B_OPTIMIZED: Two-pass EBU R128 normalization with stereo-linked true-peak control.
processing.C_REFINED: B method with objectively selected lower loudness target to reduce transient intervention.

spatial_integrity.definition: Gain-invariant binaural mix-feature fidelity relative to the approved TUK2-T007 spatial master.

gain_intervention.caution: Gain deficit includes normalization behavior and must not be interpreted as a dedicated limiter GR trace.

limitations: Spatial-integrity, transient and codec scores are technical fidelity proxies, not universal human audibility claims.
